cards.read: Sushila ka bachcha chhathe din ka hai, vajan ek kilo nau sau, sans basath ek minat men, dudh pi raha hai thik se.
Temparechar 96 digri aya, bachcha thik se dudh pi raha, vajan paune tin kilo. hemlata ka bachcha, tisra din.
Is ghar men bachche ki tatti men khun hai aur bar bar ulti kar raha hai. satrah din ka hai.
Vrishalichan bal tisrya divsachan, vajan did kilo, dudh pit nahi, ang thand lagtany.
Shubhangila tap ahe, pan balachan tapman navyannav digri ahe, balachan ang garam vatat nahi, vajan don kilo satshe.
Divya's baby, day four, weight two kilo one hundred, respiratory rate fifty-eight, no chest indrawing, feeding good.
Bipi ek sau sath bata ek sau das, elbumin ek plas. sugandha, nauvan mahina chal raha hai.
Bipi ek sau artis bata atthasi, himoglobin gyarah, bachcha hil raha hai thik, koi takliph nahin. maya, chhatha mahina.
Thoda raktasrav hotoy, ani potat khup dukhtany. megha, 29 athvade.
Hb sarhe nau hai, BP 118/78, weight 49 kg, fetal movement normal. purnima, 30 weeks.
Dilivri ko char din hue, bukhar 101 hai, niche se badbu nahin a rahi. ramapyari.
Balantpananantar pachva divas, tap ekshe tin, thandi vajte. ranjna.
